# Magnesium

> Magnesium is a stateless Sass toolkit that turns Sass maps into scoped, prefixed CSS custom properties, with token validation, cascade layers and color-scheme scoping.

## Docs

- [What is Magnesium?](https://magnesium.dev/guide/what-is-magnesium): the define → emit → consume model
- [Getting Started](https://magnesium.dev/guide/getting-started): requirements, installation and first usage
- [Configuration](https://magnesium.dev/guide/configuration): the global `$prefix` option
- [Functions](https://magnesium.dev/guide/functions): `name()`, `ref()`, `refs()`, `validation()`, `variable()`
- [Mixins](https://magnesium.dev/guide/mixins): `emit()`, `theme()`, `scheme()`
- [Patterns](https://magnesium.dev/guide/patterns): token layers, component theming, dark mode, aliasing
- [What's New in v5](https://magnesium.dev/guide/whats-new)
- [Migrating from v4](https://magnesium.dev/guide/migration)
